title: Kula burn scar fencing and native replanting
summary: The Kula Community Watershed Alliance is fencing and replanting the steep burn scar, with over a thousand plants in the fully fenced upper section and over 30,000 growing in its nursery. Over 200 deer have been removed in the past year, and the group hopes more fencing by the end of the year will let it plant hundreds of thousands of native plants. On September 9, the chair offered to contact the group about a volunteer app in development.

timeline.text: The Kula Community Watershed Alliance announced it joined the regional Maui Resilience Partnership to scale up native reforestation and fire-break fencing.
